title: Using Objects and Methods
snippet: Data types, variables, and class methods.
description: Unit 1 introduces foundational Java concepts, including variables, data types, and the basics of calling methods from provided classes.

title: Selection and Iteration
description: Unit 2 covers conditional statements and loops to create programs that make choices and repeat actions.

title: Class Creation
description: Unit 3 focuses on designing user-defined classes to model real-world entities with behaviors and attributes.

title: Data Collections
snippet: Data structures, standard algorithms, and recursion.
description: Unit 4 introduces data structures for managing collections, standard algorithms for searching and sorting, recursion, and ethical considerations around data use.
